content: Take a first glimpse of an ambitious new chapter for RuneScape: a fourth RuneScape MMO, built for a new generation of players. Still early in development, the as-yet-unnamed title will bring the world of Gielinor to life in Unreal Engine, combining the depth, freedom and community-led spirit that have defined RuneScape for 25 years with the technology and game design possibilities of today. #ign #gaming

chineseContent: 抢先一睹 RuneScape 雄心勃勃的新篇章：第四款 RuneScape MMO，专为新一代玩家打造。这款尚未命名的游戏仍处于开发初期，将在虚幻引擎中将 Gielinor 的世界带入生活，将定义 RuneScape 25 年来的深度、自由和社区主导精神与当今的技术和游戏设计可能性相结合。 #ign #游戏
